score_notes.novelty: The deflate codec is a genuinely new found-object in the catalogue (a browser API as critic) and the compression-ratio-as-aesthetic-verdict mechanism could only live on the web; this opens a location the prior twenty-year argument hadn't touched.
score_notes.nuance: Strongly double-coded — the surface gag ('which picture is the biggest file?') and the literate reading (Birkhoff/Bense/Moles refuted by their own formula) coexist without wall-text explanation, and the restraint is exemplary; falls just short of 5 because the Gradient specimen leans slightly decorative and a couple of the readymade specimens don't quite carry both readings as hard as the Void and Chance do.
score_notes.narrative: Names a precise four-name lineage (Birkhoff, Bense, Moles, Shannon) and sits the five specimens explicitly along the chance↔order axis the catalogue has been drawing since A Chance of Order and Maleglitch; the information-aesthetics angle is a genuine new thread in the twenty-year argument but the move (stage a historical theory through a web mechanism) follows an existing pattern rather than breaking new narrative ground.
score_notes.craft: Single HTML file, ~120 lines of JS, the compressor is the whole instrument and nothing else is bolted on; the table-of-measurements layout, the crown, and the graceful 'beauty cannot be computed here' fallback are all load-bearing and nothing obvious is left to remove.
score_notes.wit: The punchline lands twice — 'It has read Birkhoff. It has not looked at the pictures' on the surface, the void-as-most-beautiful on re-reading — and the fallback line ('It remains, as ever, unquantified') is the kind of dry, self-aware closure the cheerful-cynic voice wants.

references_named: Abraham A. Moles, Information Theory and Esthetic Perception (1958)
Claude E. Shannon, A Mathematical Theory of Communication (1948)
rationale: The work takes Birkhoff's 1933 formula M = O/C and literally enacts it through the browser's deflate encoder: bytes removed = order, bytes kept = complexity, and the ratio crowns the emptiest canvas. This is a textbook instance of P1 — the codec is not illustrating information aesthetics, it is performing the measurement. It opens genuinely new catalogue territory (the compression algorithm as a digital readymade, information aesthetics as a new lineage thread) while sitting legibly on the chance↔order axis the practice has been drawing for fifteen years. The punchline is dry, restrained, and lands without explanation; the void winning is both the surface joke and the literate refutation of the whole quantification project.
reservations: The Gradient specimen is the weakest of the five — it carries the axis but not much double-coding, and reads slightly decorative next to the Void, Suprematist, Composition, and Chance. The 'Re-measure' button only genuinely re-rolls the Chance specimen (the others are deterministic per visit), so the live/regenerative promise is slightly asymmetric with what the button implies.
revision_suggestion: Either swap the Gradient for a more pointed specimen that also double-codes at both depths (e.g. a Reinhardt near-black or a Perlin-noise field that scores between Gradient and Chance) or re-roll all five per click so the 're-measure' button lives up to the 'only change' manifesto.
